## Verification (2026-08-11, after change 1623 merged as 92233aed8d)

- Gerrit change 1623: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted and MERGED.
- Real-world reproduction on the live store (3823 ticket directories, 2137 commits, 620 with a
  bare 4-hex subject): derive_caused_by for this very bug now returns in **0.06s** with no
  ambiguity output, against the ~9 minutes of alias scanning measured before the fix.
- Regression tests verified RED before GREEN: against the pre-fix blame.py, 10 of the new tests
  fail, including the two noise tests failing with the exact reported text
  "Error: Ambiguous prefix ...". The 5 behaviour-preservation tests pass against BOTH versions
  -- the negative control proving no id form gained or lost the ability to resolve.
- Gates: make lint, make typecheck, full tests/unit (9386 passed), tests/interfaces subset,
  and the local mutation gate (successful skip -- these files are not protected shards).
